faq.name: faq
faq.title: Questions about early access and site drafts

items.title: Is ShipFire free to start?
items.description: Yes for getting started: you get a free allowance of site generations. Custom domains, higher limits, and extra publish features use paid credits or plans.

items.title: Can I generate a website today?
items.description: Not fully yet. ShipFire is early access / coming soon. Use the tool area to try the brief flow now; free site generations open as we ship.

items.title: What does early access include?
items.description: Early access focuses on describing your business and preparing for website drafts. Editing and publish extras roll out in stages—we mark what is live versus coming soon.

items.title: Can I edit the site after AI generates it?
items.description: That is the intended flow: generate a draft, then refine copy and structure yourself. Editing tools ship with the product—we will not claim live controls that are not ready.

items.title: What counts as a generation?
items.description: One generation is one AI website draft from your description. Loading this page, reading examples, or filling the brief does not use a free run.

items.title: How many free site drafts do I get?
items.description: The free allowance is capped and shown in your account when generation opens. Exact numbers may change during early access; paid credits unlock more runs when you need them.

items.title: Will I get a custom domain?
items.description: Publishing to a custom domain is planned as a paid / upgrade path. Early access focuses on website drafts and clear limits first.

items.title: Do I need to sign in?
items.description: Browsing the page is open. Signing in lets us track free runs and credits when generation is live. Sign-in requirements for each action are shown next to the tool.

items.title: How is this different from a static template?
items.description: Templates start from the same layout for everyone. An AI Website Builder drafts structure and copy from your description, then lets you edit. Always review and correct the result before publishing.

items.title: Can I export the site?
items.description: Export options are on the roadmap with publishing. Until then, treat drafts as editable starting points inside ShipFire—not a guaranteed downloadable code package.

items.title: What if the AI draft is wrong?
items.description: Expect to rewrite facts, pricing, and legal claims yourself. AI fills structure and starter copy; you remain responsible for accuracy before anything goes live.

items.title: Who is ShipFire for?
items.description: Solo founders, small businesses, and creators who want a first website fast without a full design cycle—and still want room to edit after the draft.
